choice.basis: The dashboard shows a monotonic decline from 23.9°C in 2005 to 10.1°C in 2014, a full-period drop of 13.8°C. No numeric threshold or default-routing policy is printed on the chart or form, so the decision rests on the magnitude of the observed change. A 13.8°C decrease over the review period is a large, sustained shift rather than ordinary variation, and the routing criterion asks whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up. The record is not being retired, so archive filing does not apply.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 river temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
